notes:
ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only (own tab, no HTTP tooling). https://shop.vtwonen.nl loaded directly with no consent wall and no WAF challenge. robots.txt re-checked in the tab: standard Shopify block list for User-agent: *, plus Nutch and CCBot disallowed; no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot rule, so no Claude-specific disallow. Platform is Shopify (vtwonen webshop operated by DPG Media, same fonQ-style marketplace catalogue as SR 121 fonq.nl - orchestrator may want a cross-check).

TREE: taken from the site's own navigation, two sources combined. (1) The header mega-menu (226 unique /collections/ links read from the DOM of the homepage). (2) Each collection page carries its own subcategory chip slider (a.bubble-slider__link), which is DEEPER than the mega-menu - e.g. /collections/banken exposes Chaise longues, Bankjes, Daybeds and 2,5-zitsbanken that the mega-menu omits. The chip slider was walked for every furniture group. One level deeper than that the chips turn into colour/material/feature filter collections (e.g. eetkamerstoelen -> 'Beige eetkamerstoelen', 'Houten eetkamerstoelen', 'Eetkamerstoelen draaibaar'; barkrukken -> 'Houten barkrukken', 'Bruine barkrukken'; bedden -> 'Houten bed'), which are excluded under brief section 3. So the leaf level used here is department > group > product type. sitemap_collections_1.xml (1589 collections) was also read and title-scanned for furniture slugs to confirm nothing large was missed.

QTY METHOD: the collection pages render 'N resultaten voor <Category>' above the grid; that header is produced client-side by Searchanise from searchserverapi1.com/getresults with q='', collection=<handle>, restrictBy[quantity]=1| and the shop's market catalog id. Counts were read from that same API, called from the loaded page in my tab (never from outside the browser). Equality with the rendered header was verified twice: /collections/banken rendered '8198 resultaten voor Banken' vs API totalItems=8198, and /collections/eetkamerstoelen rendered '2601 resultaten voor Eetkamerstoelen' vs API totalItems=2601. Shopify products_count / collections.json metafields were deliberately NOT used (known inflated).

SANITY CHECKS: (a) the number changes per collection (8198 / 2748 / 2601 / 6 ...), so it is not a site-wide constant. (b) Site-wide total is 79619; a non-existent collection handle makes the API silently return that 79619, so every handle was additionally HEAD-checked for HTTP 200 - 404s (stapelbedden, hoogslapers, kinderkasten, kinderkamer) were discarded, not recorded. (c) Roll-up coherence: banken 8198 vs the sum of its 12 chip children 8189 (99.9%); tafels 3953 vs children 3901; kasten 2502 vs children 2356; badkamermeubels 373 = badmeubels 12 + badmeubelsets 105 + kolomkasten 54 + toiletmeubels 35 + wastafelonderkasten 149 + badkamerrekken 18, exactly. (d) h1 of every page fetched matched the handle requested. (e) banken and eetkamerstoelen were each read twice with identical values, so no intra-session drift. Counts are in-stock-restricted, which is the site's own default and the number shoppers see.

NOT IN THE MEGA-MENU BUT INCLUDED: 'Badkamermeubels' (bathroom furniture) is a fully formed category page with its own chip slider and 373 products, but the badkamer department in the mega-menu only links textiles, accessories and sanitary ware. It was found via the sitemap and is recorded here because brief section 1 explicitly puts bathroom vanity/cabinet furniture in scope; the group row is flagged. Same for three nursery furniture leaves (wiegjes, commodes, babykamer-kasten) that exist as real collections but are not linked from the baby & kids menu; that group row is flagged too.

EMPTY, THEREFORE DROPPED: laptoptafels, kinderstoelen, opbergbankjes, meegroeibedden, medicijnkastjes, spiegelkasten - all returned 0 in-stock products.

EXCLUDED AND WHY: lighting (verlichting and all lamp children), mirrors (spiegels), clocks, posters, paintings, vases, candles, artificial plants, pots and planters, tableware/glassware/cookware, rugs, cushions, throws, bedding, wallpaper, paint - all out of scope per section 1. Furniture parts: tafelpoten, tafelonderstel, bankpoten, bankonderdelen, bedonderdelen, meubelbeslag/grepen/scharnieren/knoppen. Covers and protectors: tuinmeubelbeschermers, bankhoezen, tafelhoezen. Shade/structures: parasols, tuinoverkappingen, tuinzonwering. Textiles filed under garden: tuinkussens, stoelkussens. Standalone storage (future Storage task): tuin-opbergboxen, opbergboxen, opbergdozen, opbergkisten, opbergmanden, opbergrekken (checked the tiles - device holders and boxes, not shelving furniture), schoenenopbergers, onderbedboxen. Kapstokken (530) checked and excluded: predominantly wall-mounted coat-hook racks plus a few clothes rails, not furniture; halaccessoires (94) is doorstops and umbrella stands. Wandplanken-en-rekken sits under Wanddecoratie and is wall shelving, so it belongs to Wall Decor, not here. Badkamerrekken (18) excluded as bathroom shelf racks/accessories. Keukentrolleys (20) excluded - filed by the site under Huishouden > Opbergers and the tiles are small Yamazaki organiser trolleys. Mattresses (babymatrassen, kindermatrassen, boxspring-zonder-matras) excluded as bedding. Krabmeubelen (cat scratching posts) and werkbanken-opbergsystemen (DIY workbenches) excluded. Sale / Nieuw binnen / brand and 'shop-<partner>' collections excluded per section 3.

DE-DUPLICATION: nachtkastjes appears under both Kasten and Slapen, bureaus under both Tafels and Meubels, krukken/poefs/zitzakken under both Stoelen and Meubels; each is recorded once, under the group where the site's own chip slider places it.
